The '''Starship Graveyard''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that was home to the remains of dozens of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that had been shot down during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3665 BBY]]. Two significant ships in the area were the ''[[Vehement Sword]]'', which had broken in half and was referred to as the "Broken Blade" by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]; and the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'', a massive [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] dreadnought that remained intact after it crashed to the surface.
During the [[war against Zakuul]], the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Star Fortress]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the planet caused more wrecks to crash into the surface, while the Eternal Empire did nothing to stop the fighting over the shipwrecks.
